- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/docker-compose.test.yml.j2:27, 31-34 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The compose template was reported to have an extra `}` in a Jinja expression.
  WHY: Deepseek and minimax both flagged a `}}}` typo, while later reviewers said the brace sequence is actually correct shell/Jinja balancing, so the finding remains disputed but the highest reported severity is critical.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/00_canary.sh.j2:6 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The canary template was reported to have the same extra `}` in its Jinja expression.
  WHY: Deepseek reported it as an invalid shell-script render, while later reviewers dismissed it as correct brace balancing, so this singleton finding is disputed.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:16-28 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The legacy `CUSTOM_TESTS`/`SKIP_TESTS` fallback was reported to collapse multi-item strings into one JSON array element.
  WHY: That changes env-override behavior for multi-command values like `cmd1 && cmd2`, and one reviewer treated it as intentional while the others reported it as a regression.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:35-44, 67-85 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Both inline Python parsers were reported to call `json.loads()` without handling malformed input.
  WHY: Bad `CUSTOM_TESTS_JSON` or `SKIP_TESTS_JSON` can raise an uncaught `JSONDecodeError` and print a traceback; one reviewer treated this as hardening-only because the JSON is normally generated.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/_lib/graceful_shutdown.py.j2:35-56 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The graceful-shutdown helper was reported to succeed only when `app_service_running()` is true, inverting the shutdown check.
  WHY: This can make the helper time out when the app is absent or already exited, though one reviewer argued the stricter contract is intentional.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:28, 87 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The diagnostics were reported to point at the wrong variable or root cause.
  WHY: The messages reference `CUSTOM_TESTS_4` even when the actual failure may be the legacy conversion or malformed JSON, which can mislead debugging.
- workflow-templates/validation-harness/python-mongo-repo-checks/tests/40_repo_checks.sh.j2:18,89 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The empty-custom-tests diagnostics were reported to blame `CUSTOM_TESTS_JSON` even when the legacy `CUSTOM_TESTS` fallback path failed.
  WHY: This can confuse debugging by pointing at the JSON variable instead of the legacy env-var path.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
